articles.title: When No Portfolio Satisfies the Mandate: Using AI to Diagnose Optimization Infeasibility
articles.summary: Portfolio optimization problems do not always have a solution. For a complex mandate, diagnosing infeasibility can become a substantial part of the portfolio construction workflow. In that circumstance, the combination of specialized optimizer diagnostics and generative AI can materially change the user experience.
